params.prompt: Turn the person in the reference photo into a black-and-white Japanese manga storyboard panel, Shonen Jump style with bold ink linework, hatching and screentones, fused with ukiyo-e surreal detail. KEEP HIS REAL LIKENESS from the photo: slim Japanese man, gentle friendly face, short side-parted dark hair, rectangular black-framed glasses, wearing a coral/salmon shirt-jacket over a striped collared shirt. Dramatic close-up portrait, focused determined eyes lit by a desk lamp, sitting at a cluttered Kyoto art studio desk covered in brushes, ink bottles, colored pencils and small trading-card-sized artworks, a toaster oven on the counter behind him. High contrast, single manga panel with border, expressive linework.
